messages:
erin: Spotted a recurring sequence across three PMs: KV eviction spikes -> token p95 jump -> autoscaler flip-flop. Opening thread to assign precise runbook/playbook edits and owners.

noah: Good call. We need a compact first-responder checklist and exact commands to avoid guesswork.

zara: I can take the runbook changes. I will add a 'First 5 min' checklist, an 'If this persists' escalation, and exact `redwoodctl` snippets. Creating RW-4999.

erin: Suggested quick thresholds for the playbook: eviction_rate > 2% for 2m = alert to Slack; eviction_rate > 5% for 5m or token_p95 > 1s = page SRE lead. Also require any temporary routing changes to include a `postmortem-RW-4999` note.

noah: Ops commands to put in the runbook (copy/paste ready):
```
# check eviction and token latency
curl -s "https://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=kv_cache_eviction_rate[1m]"
curl -s "https://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=token_latency_p95"
# reduce batch size on pool 'serve-x'
redwoodctl deploy --pool serve-x --set batch_size=4
# pin to low-mem variant
redwoodctl route set --model user-model --variant lowmem-1 --note "postmortem-RW-4999"
```

zara: I'll add the one-line 'First 5 min' at the top: 1) check eviction+latency 2) apply quick mitigations 3) notify owners 4) open incident if paging thresholds hit. PR by 2026-04-12.

ops-bot: OpsBot: ticket RW-4999 created and assigned to @zara. Due date 2026-04-12.

erin: Action items: zara runbook edits RW-4999 due 2026-04-12; noah add snippets to ops docs due EOD today; erin confirm alert thresholds in monitoring due 48h. Thanks, closing for now unless blockers. :white_check_mark:
